overview: Love Story is a 1970 American romantic drama film directed by Arthur Hiller, written by Erich Segal. It stars Ali MacGraw and Ryan O'Neal, and features John Marley, Ray Milland, and Tommy Lee Jones in his film debut. The film is about a relationship between two students at Harvard College — the upper-class Oliver Barrett IV (O'Neal) and the working-class Jenny Cavilleri (MacGraw) — who are eventually affected by tragedy.
